description: Optimized copper of the curved conformal 2.4 GHz patch on a fixed, uniform 1.6 mm FR-4 board (issue #1120): base and moved coordinates of the substrate-top surface nodes (the patch nodes among them, is_patch) with the patch and substrate-top triangles, bent frame. Every substrate node keeps its radius about the bend axis (exact on-cylinder chart morph), so the board is the undeformed R = 100 mm shell and only the etched copper (outline, corners) and the probe (feed_moved_s_y_mm, probe_w_moved_mm) change. The ground plane is the unchanged substrate bottom and is not dumped. Consumed by the Meep matched-geometry work (#1088) and benchmarks/patch_antenna_conformal/scripts/plot_patch_displacement.py.
format: node_ids, is_patch, base and moved are parallel arrays, one entry per dumped node; node_ids holds the 0-based node index in the fixture mesh. patch_triangles, substrate_top_triangles and patch_outline_loop hold 0-based indices into these local arrays, not mesh node ids (map through node_ids).
frame: bent fixture coordinates (x, y, z); bend axis parallel to y through (x = 0, z = z_axis_mm); chart s = R*atan2(x, z - z_axis), y
outline_basis: 8 clamped uniform B-splines (degree 3) per patch edge [+y, -y, +s, -s], each DOF moving its edge outward in the surface by 1 mm (mid-plane arc) per unit; carried into the slab by a smoothstep ramp from the pinned feed band (half-width 0.84 mm) to the edge on every substrate node (top, interior, ground) and decaying over the 12 mm margin; exact on-cylinder chart morph (each substrate node keeps its radius)
corner_basis: 4 corner bumps [(s_hi, y_hi), (s_lo, y_hi), (s_hi, y_lo), (s_lo, y_lo)], each moving its corner outward along the bisector by 1 mm per unit (negative = chamfer) with support 1 - smoothstep(d / 6 mm) of the chart distance to the corner, on every substrate node; exact on-cylinder chart morph
feed_basis: 2 feed DOFs along y (the bend axis): [inset: probe moves 1 mm away from the +y edge per unit; width: probe (port) width +1 mm per unit, uniform y scaling of the port faces]; rigid within 1.27 mm of the feed centre, smoothstep to 0 at 6.75 mm (the +y edge is 5.675408085 mm away), on every substrate node; moving-feed adjoint (port width / length / flux re-derived on every moved mesh)
